Name: Piggy Bank Mod
Author: MindMeltMax
TagLine: Adds a Piggy Bank to store gold
Description:
**Description :**
Allows you to store gold for saving or just for temporary safe keeping.
**Now patched to work on 1.5**

**Installation :**
1. Install [Smapi](http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)
2. Unzip file and place in mod folder
3. $$$

**Update 1.2.0 :**
Hey! it's been... not that long actually.
First of all, Happy New Years!
Second, new update, new features. These include labels for piggy banks, originally requested by **[MeiMcKorrmik](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/27278534)** with the option to show the money stored.
And also, security features for multiplayer, you can not change another player's piggy bank label, and depending on the host's preferences, you can not withdraw / deposit into another player's bank.
I am always happy to hear new ideas and hope to make the majority of them happen.
NOTE : the update changes the saved data so clear all existing banks before updating
